verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Rupture and get chain-CC'd into a trade you can't escape; you win by baiting Rupture, closing with Decisive Strike, and executing with Demacian Justice once it's up.

brief.thesis: Cho'Gath's entire lane threat is Q (Rupture), a 9-second-cooldown knock-up with a slow at 950 range; everything else he has is short-range. Garen in this lane sits at 50.5% overall and 50.8% across 248 games into Cho'Gath specifically, so this is a mechanically even lane decided by whether you eat Ruptures or dodge them.

theirWindow.what: If you get hit by Q you are slowed and knocked up, and he will follow with W (Feral Scream) to silence and zone you off further trades. Don't try to fight through this window; back off and reset.

yourWindow.what: The instant Rupture is down, walk up and force a trade with E (Judgment) and auto-attacks. Use Q (Decisive Strike) to clear any residual slow, close distance, and land the silenced bonus-damage hit before he can threaten another knock-up.

powerCurve.note: Both sides poking, Rupture dictates spacing
Feral Scream silence punishes aggressive engages
Demacian Justice threatens execute, forces caution
Stridebreaker/Phantom Dancer let you run him down

start.why: Taken in 56.4% of games at 49.7% win rate; the extra sustain and damage reduction blunts poke from Rupture and Vorpal Spikes while you wait out his Q cooldown.

boots.why: 69.4% pick rate at 46.6% win; attack speed accelerates your Judgment-reset trades in the windows after his Q is down.

core.why: First item in the top build path (61.4% win over 57 games); the slow-on-hit lets you stick to him once you close distance after dodging Rupture.
Second in the dominant build order; attack speed and move speed keep you in range through his short-ranged kit.
Caps the 61.4%-winrate path; grievous wounds cuts into Cho'Gath's Perseverance-style sustain from Carnivore stacks.

situational.when: he is building tank and out-sustaining your trades
you need more burst to punish his Q cooldown window before he can reset to max range
his magic damage from Feral Scream and Feast is piling up faster than you can trade back

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through extended trades once you're inside his short-range kit, and converts to healing that offsets Vorpal Spikes chip damage during the long windows between his Qs.

summoners.why: Run at 51.3% win and 95.6% pick rate; Ignite punishes his Carnivore-fueled sustain and Flash lets you dodge Rupture or close distance the instant his Q cooldown expires.

playing.title: Track his Q cooldown constantly
playing.detail: Rupture is the only thing that threatens you at range; the second it's on cooldown you have a free window to walk up and trade with E (Judgment).

playing.title: Don't engage into his Feral Scream range
playing.detail: W (Feral Scream) silences in a cone at 300 range; if he still has it up, don't commit your full combo since you'll get silenced mid-trade.

playing.title: Use Q (Decisive Strike) to close, not just to poke
playing.detail: Decisive Strike clears any slow from Rupture and gives bonus move speed; use it specifically to chase him down after he lands a Q, not as a standalone poke.

playing.title: Save Demacian Justice for his low-HP moments post-6
playing.detail: R (Demacian Justice) at 400 range attempts to execute; hold it until he's already committed to a trade or missed a Rupture, since it has a long cooldown (140s at rank 1) and you don't get a second chance.

playing.title: Respect Vorpal Spikes in prolonged trades
playing.detail: His E passively deals damage to everything in front of him on a 0.5s cooldown whenever he autos; don't facetank extended auto-trades expecting it to fall off.

playing.title: Use W (Courage) before committing to all-ins
playing.detail: Courage deals damage around Garen for its duration; pop it right as you close distance after dodging a Q so the damage window lines up with your melee range, not before.

playing.title: Punish his Feast cooldown on all-ins
playing.detail: R (Feast) is a 60s-cooldown true-damage execute that grows his max HP on kill; if he's already used it recently he has no burst answer to your all-in, so push harder in that window.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates above come from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning on cooldown windows and trade patterns is this coach's own analysis, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit by Cho’Gath’s (Q). If hit with (Q), use [W] to get rid of its slow to close in to deal damage. Try to kill him after reaching level 6 with your ultimate.
